title: Tapping an individual line row immediately creates a single-line shift with no confirmation step
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. A multi-line work order exists; one line fits within the technician's day.
3. You are on the Schedule page in week view.
custom_steps:
1. Drag the work order onto a technician's cell.
2. In the scope picker, click one line row (do not use 'Select multiple').
custom_expected:
1. A single-line shift for that line is created immediately - no extra confirmation step.
2. The picker closes.
3. The block's last text line shows the line's name.
